title: In China, 9 of 10 Payments Are by Phone — Your Card May Not Buy Lunch | China Travel Expert
description:
Nine in ten payments in China happen by phone — show up with only a Visa and you may not buy lunch.

Alipay and WeChat Pay together handle well over 90% of payments in China — street stalls, taxis, temple tickets, all by QR code. A foreign Visa or Mastercard is still rarely accepted at the counter. The fix is free and takes five minutes: before you fly, set up Alipay's international “Tour Pass” or bind your card to Alipay/WeChat. Alipay recently raised the single-payment limit for foreign cards to $5,000.

🧭 Expert Tip: set it up at home on Wi-Fi — binding a foreign card needs an SMS code that's fiddly to handle the moment you land.

在中国，约九成支付靠手机扫码——只带一张Visa卡，可能连午饭都付不了。出发前把卡绑进支付宝就行。
